text: Before you go on, make sure everyone has read the plan, and agree together on how big a task is. Nothing anyone answers reaches the agent.
As the host, select Ask to read in your toolbar.
Pick one thing, such as a document, a changed file or a shared file, and a time limit, then Ask to read.
Each viewer sees what to read and the time left. Open it opens it in a tab; then I'm ready, or I have a question.
You see who is reading, who is ready and who has a question. Select Go on when you want to move on.
To estimate, select Estimate, write the task, or fill it from the plan, and pick story points or t-shirt sizes.
Everyone votes by selecting a card. Everyone sees who has voted, but nobody sees a value until you reveal them.
Then everyone sees each vote and the spread. Keep a value, or vote again.
The timeline keeps the task, the value and the spread, without names.
Read together, then estimate together, without leaving the session.
